summary_en: Ordinary dividend raised ¥8 to ¥112/share; total annual dividend ¥138/share (including ¥26 80th anniversary commemorative dividend). Prior guidance ¥130/share. Payout ratio unchanged at 30%+ or ¥100/share minimum policy. Driven by FY3/27 earnings revision: net income ¥9.5B (+500M YoY), EPS ¥359.48 (+¥19.48).
title_en: Notice regarding revision of consolidated earnings forecast and dividend forecast (dividend increase) for Q2 (interim) and full year FY3/27
translation_en_brief: Shinsho Corporation revised its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 (FY3/27) on August 6, 2026, following an upward revision to earnings guidance. The company raised its ordinary dividend by ¥8 per share to ¥112/share. Combined with a ¥26 per share 80th anniversary commemorative dividend, the total annual dividend is ¥138/share, compared to prior guidance of ¥130/share (¥65 per interim and ¥65 per year-end). The dividend policy targets a payout ratio of 30% or higher, or a minimum of ¥100/share, whichever is greater. The revision reflects stronger-than-expected first-quarter performance driven by robust demand for automotive-grade aluminum plate and semiconductor equipment aluminum plate, growth in decarbonization-related equipment and maintenance services, and favorable currency movements (yen depreciation). FY3/27 consolidated net income is now forecast at ¥9.5 billion (previously ¥9.0 billion), with earnings per share of ¥359.48 (previously ¥340.00).
